articles.title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
articles.description: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.

articles.title: Your car and its mobile app are probably handing over all kinds of data to tech companies
articles.description: Researchers at Northeastern University found vehicles and their companion apps regularly shared detailed data with some of the largest tech companies.

articles.title: a16z-backed EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation to $4B
articles.description: EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation in a year.

articles.title: Tesla secures $30B in new credit lines as it looks to scale Cybercab, Optimus
articles.description: The company says it won't draw on the new debt facilities this year, as it has already planned at least $25 billion in capital expenditures.

articles.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
articles.description: OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.

articles.title: Crypto regulation at SEC, CFTC to come down to 3 commissioners following key resignation
articles.description: Seven commissioner seats at the SEC and CFTC will be empty after Friday, leaving only a few leaders at financial regulators to oversee aspects of the $3 trillion crypto industry.

articles.title: OpenAI valuation could hit $1.4T in new funding round: Report
articles.description: OpenAI is reportedly seeking another $30 billion from investors as the ChatGPT developer pushes its long-awaited public market debut into 2027.

articles.title: OpenAI repotedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
articles.description: The new round is anticipated to be the company's last before its delayed 2027 public debut.

articles.title: Kakaopay partners with Dinari, Ondo to explore tokenized Korean stocks
articles.description: Kakaopay Securities is working with Dinari and Ondo Finance to explore tokenizing Korean-listed equities and expanding their availability to investors in international markets.

articles.title: Apple Pay set to launch in India with Axis Bank today, sources say
articles.description: Some of India's largest banks are holding off on supporting Apple Pay initially.

articles.title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents
articles.description: OpenAI isn't a public supporter of Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but it is privately working with Nvidia, TechCrunch has learned.

articles.title: Cboe, S&P Dow Jones may explore tokenized options contracts under extended licensing deal
articles.description: The agreement opens the door to tokenized derivatives as some of Wall Street's biggest institutions, including Nasdaq, NYSE and DTCC, move traditional markets onchain.

articles.title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT’s own office suite
articles.description: OpenAI's newly announced suite of office features puts it into more direct competition with more traditional software companies.

articles.title: Dutch police arrest ShinyHunters hacker accused of planning two murders
articles.description: Dutch police said the hacker, arrested for being part of the ShinyHunters cybercriminal gang, had plans to organize the murder of two people on his laptop.

articles.title: AI-powered app maker Wabi pivots to a messaging experience
articles.description: Wabi is repositioning its prompt-based app builder as a personal AI agent that can create interfaces on demand, combining chat, apps and ongoing tasks.

articles.title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
articles.description: Dots are meant to operate independent of any specific hardware or interface, pursuing user-defined goals continuously in the background with minimal oversight.

articles.title: OpenAI gives Codex reusable cloud environments that work across devices
articles.description: OpenAI is expanding Codex with reusable cloud development environments, a revamped CLI with voice controls, new code review tools and a security-focused product for scanning repositories and preparing fixes.

articles.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol, says it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra and costs less
articles.description: OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol delivers significant improvements over GPT-6 Sol across complex professional tasks, including code writing and debugging, document understanding, and executing multi-step business workflows.

articles.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plugins with app-like interfaces and automations
articles.description: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT plugins with dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, improved discovery, and support for automations.
